source_gaps: The printed TG data as captured in the bundle (1.50 g final residue, 5.75 g first plateau on a 10.00 g sample) admit no stoichiometric Al2(C12O6).xH2O within displayed tolerances: plateau 1 requires x in [22.03, 22.15] (non-integral; nearest integer x = 22 leaves 4.26 g, not 5.75 g) while plateau 2 with H = Al2O3 requires x in [21.29, 21.54] (non-integral; nearest integer x = 21 leaves 1.52 g, not 1.50 g). The two plateaus are mutually inconsistent for any single integer x. This is proved by tg_system_inconsistent in IChO2026Problems/problem_icho_2026_t1_a6.lean. No answer-blind reconstruction of the intended numbers was possible from the problem text alone without contradicting one of the displayed measurements.
